item: capture-render-quality-v1 §1 — gsplat antialiased + MCMC (corpus A/B, then flip defaults)
privacy: Metrics and text only. Corpus splats/renders stay on gj-corpus:/open-video-recon/<slug>/retrain-ab-*/; the Owner bedroom (AUTH #046) stays on the box (chmod 700), the private Modal volume and the private bucket. Nothing media-derived is committed.

flag_confirmation_nerfstudio_1_1_5.source: nerfstudio v1.1.5 nerfstudio/models/splatfacto.py (SplatfactoModelConfig), checked against the tagged source and the box copy /tmp/nsx
flag_confirmation_nerfstudio_1_1_5.rasterize_mode: --pipeline.model.rasterize-mode {classic|antialiased} — real field, default classic. Emitted by render_quality.splatfacto_quality_args on the ns-train half.
flag_confirmation_nerfstudio_1_1_5.strategy: --pipeline.model.strategy does NOT exist in 1.1.5 (Splatfacto always builds DefaultStrategy; strategy/max_gs_num arrived after 1.1.5 via nerfstudio PR #3548). MCMC on this pin = gsplat 1.4.0 MCMCStrategy swapped in by ns_train_capped.install_mcmc via --mcmc-cap N on the own-args half (render_quality.ns_train_capped_own_args).
flag_confirmation_nerfstudio_1_1_5.behaviour_preserved: quality-30k / -camopt / -mcmc recipes stay antialiased: Modal callers build the config with trainer.recipe_rasterize_mode(profile); the default scaled-10k-dense path now emits rasterize-mode classic explicitly (same as nerfstudio's default).

base_recipe: quality-30k (30k schedule + bilateral grid + scale regularisation), splat_budget 400,000 (device display budget; train at budget, never prune after), L40S, reusing each room's saved frames + SfM so held-out views (every 8th image) are identical across arms

corpus_rooms.why: domestic interior closest to a bedroom

bedroom_owner_room_01_auth_046.to_run: classic-default only (1 run) via owner_retrain --profiles quality-30k --rasterize-mode classic --tag-suffix ab-classic-400k
bedroom_owner_room_01_auth_046.note: Bedroom result is one input, not the decision: phase 2a already shows MCMC losing there; judge on the corpus.

metrics: held-out PSNR / SSIM / LPIPS (ns_finish, same renderer, same views)
floater proxy: isolated + giant + needle splat shares from tools/weak_regions.py splat statistics (CPU, $0)
train wall time + cost.json per run
decision_rule: Flip ReconstructionConfig defaults (rasterize_mode, densify_strategy) per knob only if the arm wins held-out LPIPS on >= 3 of 4 corpus rooms without a mean PSNR loss > 0.3 dB and without raising the floater proxy. Expected outcome: antialiased likely flips (the shipped recipes already use it); MCMC may not (bedroom 24.10 vs 24.85). If the 2-arm result is mixed, run the single-factor arms before flipping.

cost_estimate_usd.basis: measured 2026-10-05 bedroom 30k L40S runs at 400K: $0.504 (default) and $0.537 (mcmc) per run, cost.json GPU+CPU+memory; Modal per-app bill for that 2-run app $1.08 (~$0.54/run). Corpus clips have comparable frame counts; 30k iterations dominate.

budget_check.auth_lines: Corpus: reconstruction research compute (#031 spike / #039 RunPod primary, Modal fallback / #040 Tier-2). Bedroom run: AUTH #045 ($150; ~$2.03 spent) under #046 conditions. $50/day halt not approached.
budget_check.optional_arms: Not inside the contingency together with the plan (would leave ~$1.75 of the $20). Run only after checking the live summary again.
